widget.name: PDF Template Designer
widget.description: Design PDF templates by placing overlay fields on top of a base PDF.

property.caption: Template definition
property.description: Context object for PdfTemplateDefinition. Required in Designer mode; optional in Viewer mode.

property.caption: Template JSON
property.description: LongString attribute that stores the template JSON.

property.caption: Base PDF options
property.description: Datasource that returns PdfTemplate objects selectable for the Base PDF association.

property.caption: Base PDF association
property.description: Association from PdfTemplateDefinition to PdfTemplate (FileDocument).

property.caption: On change
property.description: Action executed whenever the template JSON changes from editor interactions.

property.caption: On save
property.description: Action executed after saving TemplateJson (usually a commit microflow).

property.caption: Field key source
property.description: Choose how the Key field is edited in Field properties.

property.caption: Field key options datasource
property.description: Datasource that returns records containing allowed field key values.

property.caption: Field key option attribute
property.description: Attribute that contains the key value to use in the dropdown.

property.caption: Field key options JSON
property.description: JSON array used for dropdown values. Supports string items or objects with key/value and optional label.

property.caption: PDF.js worker URL
property.description: Text template for the PDF.js worker script URL. Leave empty to use the default worker URL.

property.caption: PDF.js script URL
property.description: Text template for the PDF.js core script URL (pdf.min.js). Leave empty to auto-derive from the worker URL or use default.

property.caption: SigWeb script URL
property.description: Optional URL to SigWebTablet.js for external signature pad integration in Viewer mode.

property.caption: Show shortcut hints
property.description: Show or hide the shortcuts help text in the editor toolbar.

property.caption: Enable keyboard shortcuts
property.description: Enable keyboard shortcuts such as undo/redo, duplicate, delete, and arrow-key nudging.

property.caption: Show field properties
property.description: Show or hide the right-side Field properties card.

property.caption: Show palette section
property.description: Show or hide the Palette section in the left sidebar.

property.caption: Show fields section
property.description: Show or hide the Fields list section in the left sidebar.

property.caption: Show pages section
property.description: Show or hide the Pages thumbnail section in the left sidebar.

property.caption: Show property: Key
property.description: Show or hide the Key editor in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Label
property.description: Show or hide the Label editor in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Show label toggle
property.description: Show or hide the flattened output label visibility toggle.

property.caption: Show property: Type
property.description: Show or hide the field Type selector in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Page
property.description: Show or hide the Page editor in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Position
property.description: Show or hide the Position (x, y) editors in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Size
property.description: Show or hide the Size (w, h) editors in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Font size
property.description: Show or hide the Font size editor in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Alignment
property.description: Show or hide the Alignment selector in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Required
property.description: Show or hide the Required toggle in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Duplicate button
property.description: Show or hide the Duplicate field button in Field properties.

property.caption: Show property: Delete button
property.description: Show or hide the Delete field button in Field properties.

property.caption: Save button text
property.description: Custom text for the Save button in the toolbar. Leave empty to use 'Save JSON'.

property.caption: View mode
property.description: Choose between full template designer mode and viewer mode (native PDF preview with AcroForm input when supported by the browser).

property.caption: Output PDF mode
property.description: Choose whether generation writes flattened static content or creates interactive AcroForm fields.
